text: This case ports extended-attribute handling into xs-rs, letting transfers preserve the extra file metadata that xs-c++ already supports, including the stream form. It matters because closing that feature gap is a prerequisite for true feature-for-feature parity before speed tuning. The scoreboard also shows noop on congress-sample still favoring xs-c++, with xs-rs taking 1.542 times as long, while the real-projects noop result is pending.
